title.narrative: 1970 Convention: Anti-illicit trafficking of cultural properties

description.narrative: The 1970 UNESCO Convention on the Means of Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property has very limited visibility in Sudan, as the Convention was endorsed by the Cabinet in November 2025 and is still pending final ratification by the President of the Sovereignty Council. As a result, its impact remains largely confined to the fields of heritage protection and law enforcement. Nevertheless, the amendment of the Antiquities Protection Ordinance, together with strengthening the capacities and awareness of law enforcement and security agencies, remains essential for combating the illicit trafficking of cultural property and improving the protection of Sudan’s cultural heritage.
